Hannah (CS): Morning all 1 BlueAtlas week0 private/VPC kick. Quick checklist: TGW attaches + route table IDs, NAT egress CIDR, firewall SR to Redwood control/telemetry IPs, CMK policy to allow cross-account KMS, and audit logs exported to customer S3 with 365d retention. Renewal note: trial usage low (~14%) but upward trend; flag AE at 40%.

Marco (Customer): Egress CIDR will be 18.52.0.0/16 via NAT. Bucket blueatlas-redwood-logs created, prefix redwood/audit. Monthly CMK rotation fine. I'll DM TGW attach and bastion IPs now.

Jules (NetEng): Please provide TGW attachment ID and private endpoint subnet IDs. For firewall SR we'll open outbound 443 and 5263 to control/telemetry CIDRs only. Healthcheck: our LB hits /live every 30s.

Tara (Security): CMK policy is currently restrictive. Draft allow for Redwood role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Access prepared; will post in ticket BA-100 and ask Marco to confirm key alias alias/blueatlas-priv-cmk. Recommend CloudTrail validation for 365d export. Note cost impact of 365d retention for account health.

InfraBot: Ticket BA-100 created: "blueatlas private deploy - TGW routes, CMK patch, firewall SR" assigned to Jules and Tara.

Hannah (CS): Actions: 1) Marco share TGW attach + route IDs + S3 PutObject perms (Marco). 2) Jules file SR for firewall & confirm LB healthcheck (Jules). 3) Tara post CMK policy diff and request final ARN/alias (Tara). Target smoke test Tue 09:00 PST.

Marco (Customer): Posted TGW attach att-0c3f4b2a and route rtb-0d4e5f6a; added PutObject for arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Access to bucket policy.

Jules (NetEng): SR-10101 opened for outbound 111.222.60.0/24:443 and 111.222.61.0/24:5263; healthcheck /live set to 30s. Will update BA-100 when SR approved.

Tara (Security): CMK patch posted in BA-100; asked Marco to confirm alias exists. Also flagged option for 90-day rotation if BlueAtlas wants stronger posture.

Hannah (CS): Thanks all 1 noting risks: CMK alias confirmation pending and audit retention cost. I'll add renewal watch and escalate AE if usage crosses threshold. Closing thread unless blockers appear.
